newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Typhoon Willie loses punch as it hits Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Willie loses punch as it hits Vietnam.

text.p: Typhoon Willie, which had been swirling off Vietnam for several days, weakened to a tropical low pressure after it landed in northern and north central provinces on Sunday evening, the meteorological centre in Hanoi said.
The centre said in a statement on Monday that the low pressure system would move in a westerly direction, weaken and then disappear.

The Disaster Management Unit, a joint project between the United Nations Development Programme and Vietnamese government, said there had been no reports of damage from storms and flooding in the areas affected and said the risk of damage was low.
The typhoon was the sixth tropical storm to threaten Vietnam this year.
Forty-four people died and an estimated $300 million of damage was caused in seven central provinces earlier this month when a tropical storm brought torrential rains and flooding.
That took to more than 430 the number of people who have died in storms and flooding in northern and central Vietnam since the beginning of July.
